Subject: Recap & next steps: Private VPC / on-prem discovery

Thanks again for the call today, James — really appreciated the context on Acme Health's compliance needs and the high-level topology you described. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key constraints: PCI scope for payment flows, data residency in us-east-1, strict inbound rules to limit egress.
- Primary objective: Validate a Private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem components) that gives you isolated compute + KMS integration.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Schedule a technical architecture review (60 min) with your infra/security leads + our Solutions Architect and Platform Engineer to walk through network/VPC peering, routing, and key management.
2) Share the current network diagram and any security questionnaire items we should pre-read.

Potential times for the architecture review (all US/Eastern): Thu 26 Feb 10:00-11:00 or Fri 27 Feb 14:00-15:00. Are either of those good for you and the security/infra folks?

I've attached a short architecture diagram we typically use as a starting point. If you can share your internal diagram or the security questionnaire, that will help us prep.

Thanks — I can send a calendar invite as soon as we lock a time.

—
Marissa Cole

Perfect — thanks for confirming, James. Fri 27 Feb 14:00-15:00 ET is on my side as well. 

Answers to your quick questions:
- KMS/HSM: Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) and can integrate with customer HSMs for key material. We'll have our Solutions Architect walk through key rollover and access controls on the architecture call.
- Networking: We support TGW peering patterns and VPC endpoints. We'll share a set of recommended firewall rules and the peering config in advance.

I've attached the Redwood reference architecture diagram (redwood-arch-diagram-v1.pdf) and a short checklist our Solutions team uses for VPC/on-prem reviews. I'll also upload the recommended firewall rule template.

If that's all good, I'll send a calendar invite for Fri 27 Feb 14:00-15:00 ET with the invite list below:

Best,
Marissa
